mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(inquiry_no) FROM tb_inquiry WHERE user_no = #{userNo} AND inquiry_delete_yn = 'N'

SELECT COUNT(i.inquiry_no) FROM tb_inquiry i INNER JOIN tb_user u ON i.user_no = u.user_no
AND i.inquiry_status = #{inquiryStatus}
AND i.inquiry_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchName}, '%')
AND u.user_nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchName}, '%')

SELECT inquiry_no, inquiry_title, inquiry_status, inquiry_created FROM tb_inquiry WHERE user_no = #{userNo} AND inquiry_delete_yn = 'N' ORDER BY inquiry_created DESC LIMIT #{request.pageSize} OFFSET #{request.startRowNum}

SELECT i.inquiry_no, i.inquiry_title, i.inquiry_status, i.inquiry_created, u.user_no, u.user_nickname FROM tb_inquiry i INNER JOIN tb_user u ON i.user_no = u.user_no WHERE i.inquiry_status = 'PENDING' AND i.inquiry_delete_yn = 'N' ORDER BY i.inquiry_created DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT i.inquiry_no, i.inquiry_title, i.inquiry_content, i.inquiry_status, i.inquiry_answer_content, i.inquiry_answer_content_text, i.inquiry_created, inf.inquiry_file_no, inf.inquiry_file_original_name, inf.inquiry_file_stored_name, inf.inquiry_file_path, inf.inquiry_file_extns_nm, inf.inquiry_file_size FROM tb_inquiry i LEFT JOIN tb_inquiry_file inf ON i.inquiry_no = inf.inquiry_no WHERE i.inquiry_no = #{inquiryNo} AND i.user_no = #{userNo} AND i.inquiry_delete_yn = 'N'

SELECT i.inquiry_no, i.inquiry_title, i.inquiry_content, i.inquiry_status, i.inquiry_answer_content, i.inquiry_answer_content_text, i.inquiry_delete_yn, i.inquiry_created, u.user_nickname, inf.inquiry_file_no, inf.inquiry_file_original_name, inf.inquiry_file_stored_name, inf.inquiry_file_path, inf.inquiry_file_extns_nm, inf.inquiry_file_size FROM tb_inquiry i INNER JOIN tb_user u ON i.user_no = u.user_no LEFT JOIN tb_inquiry_file inf ON i.inquiry_no = inf.inquiry_no WHERE i.inquiry_no = #{inquiryNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_inquiry ( user_no, inquiry_title, inquiry_content, inquiry_status, inquiry_delete_yn, inquiry_created ) VALUES ( #{userNo}, #{inquiryTitle}, #{inquiryContent}, #{inquiryStatus}, #{inquiryDeleteYn}, #{inquiryCreated} )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_inquiry SET inquiry_title = #{inquiryTitle}, inquiry_content = #{inquiryContent}, inquiry_updated = #{inquiryUpdated} WHERE inquiry_no = #{inquiryNo}
UPDATE tb_inquiry SET inquiry_delete_yn = #{inquiryDeleteYn}, inquiry_updated = #{inquiryUpdated} WHERE inquiry_no = #{inquiryNo}
